svg.text: never chmod-ed; WAL and SHM inherit it
a symlink, another owner, a group or other
after the checks; every new connection
compares them before it reads anything
replaced: the connection is closed, refused

svg.text: one connection; each job is one transaction,
in submit order, so no lock upgrade
readers keep a deferred BEGIN; WAL,
before the chain: the SQLite that Python loads needs the WAL-reset fix,
3.51.3 or later, or 3.50.7 in the 3.50 series, or 3.44.6 in the 3.44 series
after it: open_db says the index is new, a new file or no Alembic revision, and boot rebuilds it, Task 11
